claim: Strong EQ backing vectors preserve key identity and table operations over actual relocation, including cached lookup and mutation, through compiler-generated B callers.
representation: D1 hash-vector subtag 74, fourteen header payload words followed by alternating key/value words. Native track-keys and key-moved bits are retained. The full U1 HASH-TABLE structure is not materialized.
algorithm: Address-word mixing with bounded linear probing replaces U1 bucket arithmetic. Movement sets key-moved on the copied vector; the next operation rebuilds its buckets in owner scratch and invalidates the cache before using it. Strong keys, values and cache slots are traced.
generated: Nine modules from the unchanged accepted compiler: ordinary tail calls, APPLY, multiple-value bind/prog1/call, and live values across collection and collecting cleanup. Owner-installed hand-built B runtime adapters call the C/Wasm primitive directly, without JavaScript on the operation path.
owner: One synchronous Worker. The owner creates fixed-capacity vectors and supplies exact extents, disjoint scratch/result storage, semispaces and trusted callable entries. Raw malformed-table refusals do not claim arbitrary heap integrity validation or an untrusted host boundary.
limits: Only strong EQ vectors; weak, frozen and other hash-vector flags refuse collection.
Capacity is a power of two from 4 through 16384; full insertion is a checked refusal. Automatic table growth is not implemented.
No MAKE-HASH-TABLE, GETHASH or SETF source rewrite is added; generated code reaches the implemented operations through ordinary function values.
No native CLOS HASH-TABLE wrapper, user hash tests, iteration order, weak semantics, cross-Worker sharing or pinned hash-vector inventory is claimed.
The hand-built adapters are internal B leaves, not public host entries or lazy-loader catalog modules. Invalid runtime arguments use checked refusals, not Lisp conditions.
No performance claim. Cache hits and ordinary bucket probes stay in Wasm; a rehash uses owner scratch and runs without a safepoint.
